name: IsTriangle.weightedChain_descent
summary: Induction on n: the case n = 0 is the first-arrow law; the step moves one more square with the square law.

steps.claim: Induction on n; for n = 0 take β = κ = 1 (M(0, 1) and the first-arrow adjointness, h.1 and h.4).
steps.lean: induction' n with n H; use 1, 1; simp [h.1, h.4 i hi]

steps.claim: For n + 1: from the induction hypothesis H (with i + n < m) the coefficient and law (e, r, u); from the square law at (i, n) (h.3) β′, the cost and the adjoint law (f, s, c, p, q).
steps.lean: choose _ _ e r u using H hi.le; choose! _ f s _ c _ p q using h.3 i n hi

steps.claim: Take the products of the constants: the identity (1) follows by comparing inner products with every vector (`ext_inner_left`), and the cost M(n + 1, κβ) from the multiplicativity of M (h.2); (2) by the adjoint law.
steps.lean:
refine ⟨_, _, fun t y ↦ ext_inner_left ℂ ?_, fun g ↦ ⟨(mul_mul_mul_comm ..).subst (h.2 (r g)
    (h.2 (c g) (s g) .refl) .refl), ?_⟩⟩ <;> simp [← inner_conj_symm _ (a _ i n.succ _), *, field]
